Week 27 Module Map: Cattle Kingdom: The Railroads and the Open Range Era

Quarter 3: The Price of Union

The frontier's closing produces an economic boom: the open range, the great drives, and then the range's own closing a generation later.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: The Open Range and the Great Cattle Drives
  • Lesson 2: Cattle Barons and the Closing of the Range

What to turn in

  • Reading quiz: Week 27 Reading Quiz
  • Primary source assessment: Week 27 Primary Source Assessment
  • VR write-up: Week 27 VR Write-Up, based on your immersive session
  • Quarter 3 exam: Quarter 3 Exam, covering Weeks 19 to 27

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.

Something to watch for

Self-government: notice what happens in the Mason County War when people have no peaceful way to settle disputes.
